annotationPolicy.help: Instruction, reading, public explanation or guide; distinguish from actual catalogue search or application execution.
annotationPolicy.academic: Institutional academic/education functions, not every text mentioning a university or training.
annotationPolicy.actions: Ordinary HTTP(S) sources navigate, including different-document fragments and public login form links; same-document fragments, actual buttons/roles/aria controls/haspopup, original inline handlers, explicit JS/popup/download/SSO/OAuth/SAML/authorize signals, and named targets locate.
annotationPolicy.dataEvalId: Evaluation mapping only; not a source-site semantic signal.
annotationPolicy.extraRetainedControls: All extra retained controls have explicit accepted/rejected coverage. Hidden controls are rejected in the captured default state.

fidelityLimitations: Bounded source-block fixtures are not complete websites and do not preserve delegated external JavaScript execution or pixel layout.
Effective display, visibility, and opacity are preserved from the observed default state with presentation-only inline styles; original source style metadata are preserved in observations.
No scripts, asset requests, input values, typed user content, downloads, authentication, or business actions are included or executed.
Fresh headless pages may differ from a manually operated installed extension or user session; no claim of actual human task success.

collectionIssues.issue: Library public scripts replace global Map, breaking Playwright object argument/result serialization.
collectionIssues.resolution: Use primitive JSON strings for page.evaluate arguments/results and avoid Map in observer capture code; no page function or product code was activated.
